AALTO, a global leader in Stratospace. Based in Farnborough, AALTO is an Airbus subsidiary that manufactures, operates, and delivers services with its solar-powered, stratospheric platform: Zephyr.

· Participate in technical reviews, challenge assumptions constructively and help strengthen engineering best practice.
· Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, accountability and continuous improvement.

· Strong problem-solving, debugging and analytical skills, with the ability to work methodically through complex technical issues.
· A collaborative communication style and the confidence to work effectively with engineers from multiple disciplines.
· Awareness of related standards such as DO-330, DO-331, DO-332, DO-333, ARP4754A/B, DO-278, DEF STAN 00-55 or DEF STAN 00-56 would be advantageous.
Why This Role Stands Out

# Account Manager, Financial Services
London, Greater London, England, United Kingdom
## **About AlphaSense:**
The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
**About the Team:** The Customer Success team is composed of our Product Specialist group, a team of highly trained product experts as well as our Account Managers, who provide strategic guidance to our robust book of business, spanning from Fortune 1000 businesses to some of the largest financial institutions in the world. First and foremost, the Customer Success team are value added partners to our clients. We are extremely consultative in our approach and will do everything we can to solve for client challenges through our product. We spend our waking hours obsessing over our customers and making sure they have the right data at their fingertips to make the best decision possible. We are responsible for retaining our customers, maximizing usage of the product and partnering with the sales team to uncover opportunities to grow our business.
**About the Role:** The Account Manager, Financial Services is responsible for developing three-dimensional relationships with customers and key stakeholders in order to effectively retain and grow our customer base. In this role, you will serve as our Financial clients’ main point of contact for inbound queries, outbound engagement, relationship updates, and renewal discussions. You’ll need to be versatile. You will work with a variety of clients from Hedge Funds, Asset Managers, Investment Banks to Private Equity and more.. In this role, you’ll be expected to collaborate with account executives, identifying new business opportunities to help expand our footprint within each client account. While key performance indicators include retention rate and the identification of growth opportunities, the responsibilities of Account Managers go much deeper. The team also extracts a wealth of knowledge from our clients, bringing that internally to product, marketing and sales teams in order to maximize the effectiveness of our business’ strategy and communication.
**Who You Are:**
* **Relationship-driven:** You have a strong ability to develop instant rapport with new people and you’ve demonstrated success at managing and growing relationships within Fortune 1000 clients and/or financial services companies
* **A subject matter expert:** You excel at what you do and know how to succeed within your role -- this includes both internal and external relationship management as well as strong business acumen and commitment to effective processes and tactics
* **Energetic and Creative:** You possess a natural intellectual curiosity with the ability to learn and adapt quickly
* **You understand our business:** We are a rapidly growing SaaS company and are incredibly passionate about our product. We are looking for individuals who understand best practices for client engagement within a SaaS environment; preferably with exposure to AI and/or research-based products
* **Committed to delivering results:** You set the example for grit, work ethic, initiative, enthusiasm and commitment amongst your peers.
* **A strong communicator:** You’ll regularly be engaged with anyone from an Analyst to a C-level executive and that requires exceptional oral, written and presentation skills. You’ll need to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms.
**What You’ll Do:**
* Maximize retention rate across the book of business
* You’ll increase and drive adoption of AlphaSense solutions into other business units of existing clients to uncover new opportunities, exceeding monthly, quarterly and annual revenue goals
* Identify revenue at risk in order to best position the company to prevent churn
* Forecast retention rates
* Collaborate with Account Executives to identify growth opportunities within the book of business
* Understand the ins and out of the business, roles, responsibilities, projects, performance metrics, etc. within our client base in order to more effectively: 1) communicate with users, 2) communicate with decision makers, 3) identify white space, 4) partner with AE to craft most compelling messaging to prospective users
* Cultivate relationships with users and key stakeholders to ensure AlphaSense is viewed as a business partner rather than vendor
* Hold Business Reviews with key stakeholders
* Plan and execute new user onboarding and training initiatives
* Consistent proactive outreach with material and information that’s relevant for our user base
* Serve as our boots on the ground and physical presence within each client (floor walks, lunch and learns, etc.)
* Serve as both the advocate for AlphaSense to the client, and the client advocate within AlphaSense
* Acquire value stories and product feedback from clients. Circulate internally to assist with product development, marketing, sales efforts
* Allocate time effectively to work most closely with high and mid-touch accounts

Stacks is building an AI-native platform that reinvents how modern finance teams run the monthly close. The opportunity is massive: every growing company depends on accurate, timely financial data, yet most are still operating with tools and workflows built for a different era.

job_description:
The Triage Intelligence and Debug Engineering team operates at the deepest
layers of Apple's software stack, with a mandate that spans the entire product
ecosystem. The work we do directly shapes the reliability of over 2 billion
active Apple devices — every crash triaged, every panic root-caused, and every
automated pipeline we build contributes to the OS stability that hundreds of
millions of people depend on every day. We partner closely with engineering
teams across Apple to drive that reliability end-to-end, influencing how the
entire organization detects, understands, and resolves systemic failures.
DESCRIPTION

OS internals, automation, and intelligent systems. The impact of this role is
broad and direct — your investigations will uncover failures affecting Apple's
entire device ecosystem, your contributions will touch software running across
iPhone, Mac, and Apple Silicon, and the automation pipelines you help build will
shape how reliability engineering scales across Apple. You will dig into the
operating system to understand the true origin of crashes and panics — not just
the symptom at the top of a stack trace, but the underlying system-level
conditions that caused it. You will operationalize that understanding by
encoding triage logic into automation pipelines, and explore how ML and AI
techniques can make those pipelines smarter over time. You will collaborate
across Software, Hardware, and Silicon Engineering teams to drive issues all the
way to resolution. This role is a strong fit for an engineer who is eager to
learn how operating systems work at a deep level, excited to build scalable

Experience or interest in collaborating across silicon, firmware, or platform

# Senior Marketing Data Analyst
**About ApprovalMax**
ApprovalMax provides end-to-end accounts payable automation for businesses using cloud accounting systems such as Xero and QuickBooks Online. We have 20,000+ businesses worldwide across 70+ countries, and strong product-market fit built over 8+ years. Our customers, accountants, bookkeepers, and finance teams are risk-averse, non-technical users who rely on us to control how money leaves their business.
***Remote —* applicants must be based in the UK, Portugal, Serbia or Moldova.**
**Role Overview:**
Reporting to the Head of Analytics, you will own the analytical relationship between the Data Team and the Marketing function. This is a dual role, you will do serious analytical work, building the models, dashboards, and insights Marketing relies on, and you will own how Marketing uses data, setting the rhythms, SLAs, and standards that make analytics a genuine partner to the business rather than a service desk. The measurement layer underneath Marketing (attribution, tracking taxonomy, UTM standards, the HubSpot property schema, and the definitions behind the funnel numbers) has grown organically and needs to be rebuilt deliberately. You will be the person who does that, and then keeps it honest.
This isn’t a role where you’ll be handed a brief and asked to execute. You’ll help shape how embedded analytics works at ApprovalMax, with real influence over the model from day one. **8**0% marketing analytics, 20% wider data contribution, including mentoring, standards and best practices across the business.
**Key Responsibilities:**
Marketing Analytics
* Own the analytical relationship with the Marketing function: understand their priorities, anticipate their data needs, and deliver analysis that drives decisions rather than merely informing them.
* Build and maintain the core dashboards, reports, and models Marketing relies on, and take responsibility for their accuracy, freshness, and usability.
* Own the analysis behind the funnel that matters most to the business: visitor → free trial → paid conversion, trial nurture performance, lifecycle-stage progression, and the leading indicators that move them.
* Quantify channel and campaign performance end to end (spend, CAC, payback, pipeline contribution and retained revenue) rather than stopping at platform-reported conversions.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into clear analytical frameworks; make assumptions explicit and deliver useful outputs before perfect data is available.
* Bring cross-functional context to Marketing analysis, combining product usage, subscription revenue, and CRM data to surface insights a channel-level view would miss.
Attribution & Measurement
* Own the rebuild of marketing attribution: agree the model with Marketing and Finance, document its assumptions and known blind spots, and implement it in the warehouse so that one number is produced once and reused everywhere.
* Reconcile platform-reported numbers (ad platforms, GA4, HubSpot) against warehouse truth, and be the person who can explain — credibly and repeatedly — why they differ.
* Build the measurement approach for activity that attribution cannot see cleanly: brand, organic, partner and word-of-mouth. Incrementality and holdout testing where the spend justifies it.
* Design and analyse marketing experiments — landing pages, nurture sequences, pricing and packaging messages — including how success is defined before the test runs.
Tracking Architecture & Data Collection Standards
* Diagnose the tracking we already have, not just the tracking we intend to build: read the existing client-side implementation, cookie and local-storage handling, and referrer behaviour to work out why a channel is misreporting. Our largest single attribution problem today is an oversized Direct segment, and unpicking it is an early priority for this role.
* Own the event taxonomy: what we track, what each event means, what properties it carries, and what it is allowed to be used for.
* Own the Google Tag Manager container (tags, triggers, variables) and the QA process that proves tracking works before and after a release.
* Own the UTM naming standard and the automated compliance checks that enforce it. Per-campaign tagging is done by whoever launches the campaign; you own the standard, the validation, and the report that shows who is out of compliance.
* Specify the dataLayer contract that the website must expose, and the requirements for server-side tracking. You write the spec and verify the result; the implementation in site code and the infrastructure underneath it are built by web engineering.
* Own tracking QA as a standing process, not a one-off project: broken tracking should be detected by a check, not by someone noticing a dashboard looks wrong three weeks later.
Marketing Data Model & Metric Definitions
* Own the custom property schema in HubSpot from a data perspective: which properties exist, what they mean, who writes them, and how they map to the warehouse model. Specify the fields; workflow build sits with Revenue Operations.
* Own the Marketing domain within the Central KPI & Metrics Glossary — MQL, SQL, opportunity, trial, activation, conversion, retention — and bring additions and conflicts to the governance process rather than letting shadow definitions accumulate.
* Make sure that when Marketing, Sales, Finance and Product quote the same metric, they are quoting the same number, and that where they legitimately differ, the difference is documented rather than argued about.
* Ensure new product features, pricing changes, or GTM motions are reflected in metric definitions and dashboards ahead of launch, not after.
Ways of Working with Marketing
* Define and document the working model between the Data Team and Marketing: metric ownership, request intake, turnaround SLAs, escalation paths, and data freshness expectations.
* Establish an explicit fast lane for time-critical marketing requests, so that urgent work can be pulled into the current week rather than waiting for the next planning cycle — and be honest, in writing, about what does not qualify.
* Document domain knowledge, stakeholder preferences, and analytical edge cases so marketing analytics can be handed off or scaled without starting from scratch.
Self-Service, Reporting & AI-Assisted Workflows
* Build and maintain dashboards and automated reports (Lightdash, Amplitude, GA4) so Marketing can answer recurring questions without an analyst in the loop.
* Write clear documentation others can verify, extend, and build on: metric definitions, methodology notes, and data caveats.
* Actively shift recurring analytical work to self-service, freeing your capacity for higher-value analysis.
* Use LLM-assisted tools and AI coding agents as a default part of your analytical workflow — for data exploration, query generation, insight synthesis, and documentation. You should be faster and more thorough because of these tools, not merely aware of them.
* Help embed agentic workflows within the Marketing team, showing stakeholders how to get answers from data directly.
* Contribute as a practitioner and user of the natural-language and text-to-SQL tooling being built by the Data Platform Lead.
Data Quality, Governance & Mentorship
* Flag data quality issues upstream to the Data Platform Lead; understand how your analyses depend on specific pipelines and contracts, and raise risks proactively.
* Treat marketing data quality as your own problem where it originates in taxonomy, tagging, or CRM property design — that is your surface, not the platform team's.
* Participate in the intake and weekly triage process; help classify and scope incoming requests from Marketing.
* Provide technical guidance, analytical framing, and code reviews for junior analysts.
* Contribute to agile workflows (Kanban/Scrum) and planning sessions; keep your work visible and priorities explicit.
* Help shape the documentation standards and analytical norms that will apply as the team scales.
**What We're Looking For:**
**Must Have's:**
* 4+ years’ experience in data analytics, ideally across marketing, growth or GTM
* Experience owning marketing measurement, attribution and tracking
* Strong diagnostic skills across tracking, attribution and data quality
* Hands-on use of AI/LLM tools in your analytical workflow
* Strong SQL and Python skills, including production-quality code
* Experience with GA4, GTM, CRM platforms (HubSpot preferred) and paid media data
* Experience with BI/product analytics tools such as Lightdash, Looker or Amplitude
* Ability to combine data across CRM, product, finance and marketing
* Strong communication skills with senior, non-technical stakeholders
* Experience with metric governance and resolving conflicting data
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning complex questions into actionable insights
**Nice to Have:**
* SaaS/B2B experience and familiarity with subscription & PLG metrics.
* Experience with product-led growth, activation and conversion analysis
* Familiarity with dbt, semantic layers and data modelling
* Experience with server-side tracking or dataLayer implementation
* Exposure to experimentation, incrementality or media-mix modelling
* Experience with embedded analytics models
* Exposure to LLMs, text-to-SQL or AI-driven data exploration
* Experience mentoring analysts or setting analytical standards
**What We Offer:**
* Health & Wellbeing Benefit Stipend
* Home Office Setup - one off £500 reimbursement, post probation
* 26 days of paid time off
* 1 additional day off for your birthday
* Service-years recognition financial reward
* Regular performance-based compensation reviews

## Job Description
**Who You'll Work With**
The OpenConfig team who are responsible for building a dynamic, **programmable data centre infrastructure** using **software-defined networking** principles such as declarative configuration and model-driven management and operations.
**What You'll Do**
Arista’s engineering team started from a blank sheet of paper to architect an entirely new networking operating system. Arista’s unique architecture is based on three guiding principles:
1. State orientation
2. Open standards-based approach
3. Single software image consistency
1) State Orientation for publish-subscribe communication
State Orientation uses a unique multi-process state-sharing architecture that separates state information from protocol processing and application logic with a central database shared by diverse applications. Both system state and data are stored in the system database where data is accessed via an automated publish/subscribe model. This distinct design principle provides module independence, self-healing resiliency, and multi-process software stability. It is an elegant distributed systems solution applied holistically right across the network. This contrasts with the decades-old legacy approach of many competitors that uses extensive inter-process communications (IPC), a shared memory bus, or a complex message passing framework to communicate across the system components.
2) An Open Approach
Arista took to heart the lessons of the open-source world and built EOS on top of an unmodified Linux kernel, maintaining full, secured access to the Linux shell and utilities. It is notable that it is the same Linux OS that Arista’s customers run in their data centers and on their servers. This foundational methodology enables EOS to preserve the security, feature development, and tools of the Linux community, unlike legacy approaches where the original **OS kernel** is either modified or based on older, less maintained versions. By adhering to open source **Linux**, EOS also natively supports Linux containers and virtual machines, simplifying the deployment of new services and enhancing DevOps practices.
3) A Single Image
Arista’s third and crucial guiding principle is to provide a single software image that runs across all products in various packaging forms - physical platforms, virtual machines, and containers. The EOS single image uses the same source code, and the same version of the software released across the entire portfolio of switches and routers, thus improving network testing and reliability while reducing the complexity and cost of network operations. This approach is a large differentiator to legacy vendors who use multiple operating systems with numerous images to implement a siloed network. Managing these multiple software images with quality control testing or new features testing multiplies operational costs. In contrast, when Arista releases a new software version, customers merely deploy a single image network-wide. In addition, having a single image improves automation workflows by allowing DevOps tools, such as Ansible or Terraform, to work across all Arista devices with a single integration. Using these integrations, operators can establish Continuous Integration (CI) pipelines that build, test, and deploy network configurations across the entire data center with increased speed and reliability.

Foundation

Communication & Collaboration

Evinova draws on AstraZeneca’s deep experience developing novel therapeutics, informed by insights from thousands of patients and clinical researchers. At Azur Technology, we’re redefining the insurance industry with powerful, AI-driven SaaS products for MGAs. We’re not your typical consultants — we work closely with our clients as an embedded product team, developing long-lasting and trusted partnerships. We’re currently 90+ people strong and have clear plans to scale the business. We play in the Salesforce stack. We configure where we can, but when we need to build, design, and communicate complex systems, we do. Whatever we do, we want to do it better. 
We are now looking for a Product Builder to join our Product team at Azur Technology. You’ll report to our Product Lead and work at the intersection of engineering, product, and the insurance business itself. The role is hybrid, requiring semi-regular office days in London. 
The role 
Your job is to turn ideas into working software that MGAs actually use. You’ll take a problem – often loosely defined, often straight out of a client conversation – and build it into a capability inside MGA Connect. Sometimes that means prototyping two or three approaches to find the right answer quickly. Sometimes it means building the thing properly so it can ship to every MGA on the platform. You own that whole arc, from concept to something real. 
This isn’t a ticket-driven role. You’ll take features end-to-end, from framing the problem with the Product Lead through to design, build, and release. That means getting close to the people who use the product. Underwriters, brokers, and operations teams will tell you what actually slows them down, and the best decisions we make come from engineers who have watched the workflow rather than read a summary of it. 
How we expect you to work 
You should be using AI tools properly. Not just autocomplete or code suggestions, but using Claude Code, Cursor, or similar to explore architecture options, scaffold entire projects, and move faster than a traditional dev workflow allows. You focus on the logic, the UX, and the system design. The tools handle the boilerplate. 
We’re not looking for someone who pastes AI output without understanding it. You need the judgment to know what to accept, what to rewrite, and when the AI is confidently wrong. 
What you'll actually do 
Design and ship features across MGA Connect, spanning policy lifecycle, submissions and quotes, renewals, claims, billing, and reporting. Prototype fast when the right answer isn’t obvious, then build the version that lasts. Work with our client-facing teams to turn recurring requests into product, rather than one-off configuration for a single MGA. Wire up APIs, data models, and integrations that connect MGA Connect to the rest of an MGA’s world. Act as a technical sounding board when the team has half-formed ideas. When someone has a crazy idea, you tell them how to build 80% of it in 20% of the time. 
We’re a Salesforce shop, and MGA Connect is built on the Salesforce platform, so most of what you ship lands there. You can prototype in whatever stack gets you to an answer fastest (React, Node, Python, serverless, whatever works), but production work needs to live where the platform lives. Bear in mind that what you build is multi-tenant. It has to hold up for an MGA writing high-net-worth home in London and one writing commercial lines in Texas. 
Why this role 
MGA Connect is the product, so what you build gets used every day by MGAs to quote, bind, and manage real business. It also shows up in every deal we win. You get real autonomy and a short path from idea to production. No six-month roadmaps, no death by committee, no waiting around for approval. If you want to see your work actually matter, this is that kind of role.  2–4+ years building technical products, tools & prototypes and ideally shipping production code. You’ve spun up projects independently, not just contributed to existing codebases. Comfortable with ambiguity. You don’t need detailed requirements to get started. Genuine experience with AI coding tools, not just curiosity about them. Product-minded: you care more about whether something works for users than whether the code is elegant. Curious about how the whole machine works. You want to understand the insurance business you’re building for, not just the codebase. 
Bonus if you’ve worked on the Salesforce platform or with its APIs, have InsurTech or B2B SaaS experience, or have played with MCP servers, agentic workflows, or tools like Lovable.  Benefits include minimum of 25 days holiday, health insurance, pension, hybrid working and dedicated training budget.

At Barings, we are as invested in our associates as we are in our clients. **Job Title**: Client Portfolio Manager – Private Credit
**Business Title:** Senior Associate / Associate Director
**Department:** Private Credit
**Location:** London
Barings’ Private Credit team is seeking a Client Portfolio Manager. This position will ideally be located in London and will report to the Managing Director, Client Portfolio Management – Private Credit.
Barings Client Portfolio Managers work in close partnership and coordination with investment teams and sales as well as other stakeholders within the organization as subject matter experts, focusing on business development, client servicing and product development for certain investment strategies.
Barings’ experience within Private Credit is extensive and is an integral part of Barings’ global capabilities. Barings’ experience within private debt is extensive and is an integral part of Barings’ global capabilities. The Private Debt platform seeks to find differentiated sources of return across direct lending, infrastructure debt, capital solutions, portfolio finance, asset-based finance and private placements.
The primary focus will be supporting the Global Direct Lending business. Barings is a scaled, global direct lender that directly originates senior secured loans to sponsor-backed companies in the core middle market. Barings remains one of the most active middle market direct lenders globally, underpinned by the scale of the platform, our track record and longstanding position as an incumbent lender. Barings has $61Bn of commitments to the Global Direct Lending platform across a diverse capital base covering various global and regional commingled fund structures, separately managed accounts and middle market CLOs. The platform has raised over $11Bn of capital over the last 12 months, as of June 30th 2026.
***Primary Responsibilities***
* Take a Client Portfolio Management role within our European Private Credit business primarily focussed on Barings’ Global and European Direct Lending capabilities but may also support some of Barings’ other Private Credit capabilities.
* Serving as a supporting business development liaison for Barings’ European Private Credit Capabilities
* Support communicating investment strategies internally and externally with the goal of growing assets under management in our regional private debt funds
* Contribute to scheduled and ad-hoc updates on all aspects of the Private Credit market including investment performance, market levels etc.
* Stay abreast of market developments and competitor intelligence
* Contribute to preparation of, and some participation in, meetings with current and prospective clients
* Collaborate with various teams internally to contribute to client proposals (RFPs) and due-diligence questionnaires (DDQs) to support the winning of new business and retaining existing clients
* Responding in a timely manner to client and prospect requests
* Attending investment team meetings, where required, to build subject matter expertise across the various investment strategies
* Participate in and coordinate product development initiatives in conjunction with the Product Development team for the Private Credit Business at Barings
* Oversee the creation of all marketing material including fact sheets and pitch books for Barings’ regional fund offerings.
* Contribute to and review reporting materials for existing clients and respond to client reporting inquiries on a timely basis
* Contribute to Thought Leadership materials, in cooperation with investment staff and Barings Marketing staff
***Qualifications***
* University degree required and a degree in Finance, Economics or related field preferred
* 3-5 years professional experience is desirable
* Strong and extensive experience in either an investment management or investment specialist role, preferably within the Alternative/Private asset industry. Private Credit experience, especially Direct Lending, is a plus.
* A passion for financial markets and a strong proficiency with general Fixed Income and Credit topics
* Excellent oral and written communication skills including an ability to assess and convey market dynamics, portfolio strategy and risk factors
* An analytical approach and problem-solving mindset
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple time-sensitive tasks and perform effectively in a team-oriented environment
* Strong proficiency with PowerPoint and Excel required, including experience using MS Office software to produce high quality presentations
* Proficient data analysis skills and AI fluency
* Self-starter with strong drive and motivation to succeed and demonstrable track record in doing so
* Ability to meet all deadlines with a strong attention to detail
* CFA or CAIA, or a willingness to seek the designation desired

In a dynamic portfolio shaped by new indications, label expansions, named-patient and compassionate use programs, and clinical-to-commercial transitions, this leader strengthens supply resilience, manages risk, and builds planning capabilities for long-term growth.
As the global process owner for IBP, you will lead forward-looking decision-making across a 24–60-month horizon, including long-range capacity planning and modelling, inventory strategy, and data analytics that support reliable supply and patient access.

**1. IBP Process Ownership in a Rare Disease Environment**
* Own the global IBP framework for rare disease planning, addressing demand variability, small batches, long lead times, and constrained capacity.
* Establish and maintain a consistent IBP cadence (Product Review, Demand Review, Supply Review, Integrated Reconciliation, Executive IBP).
* Own the S&OE (Sales & Operations Execution) process, ensuring near-term demand, supply, and inventory decisions are aligned to the broader IBP framework and escalated appropriately.

* Lead Inventory Management to define inventory policies, targets, and positioning strategies that minimize expiry while guaranteeing immediate patient access for ultra-low-volume therapies.
* Lead risk-based scenario planning for demand surges (e.g., new diagnoses, outbreaks, compassionate use clusters), supply disruptions, or single-source component issues.
**3.** **Cross-Functional Leadership** **& Governance**
* Chair IBP forums across Commercial, Clinical Operations, Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, and Medical.
* Establish governance and decision rights for trade-offs such as allocation priorities, safety stock strategies, and launch readiness.
* Lead structured decision-making in Executive IBP, ensuring senior leaders have clear scenarios, risks, and recommendations.
* Drive alignment across global, regional, and country planning, accounting for reimbursement and access variability.
**4. People Leadership:**
* Lead the team of Integrating Planning & Analytics professionals, through strong development and mentoring while creating a culture of high accountability and innovation.
* Ensure there are departmental performance goals and objectives that the team of integrated planners can leverage to develop their respective objectives and provide performance feedback related to business objectives.
* Create a training curriculum to support Integrated Planning & Analytics Team’s development responsibilities.
* Influence teams across the supply chain planning organization to improve their maturity and collaboration through a harmonized integrated planning playbook maximizing optimal support to the planning cycles.
**5. Financial & Portfolio Integration**
* Partner closely with Finance, particularly during AOP/LRP cycles, to embed operational, revenue, COGS, and margin considerations into IBP.
* Integrate portfolio plans including new indications, lifecycle extensions, label expansions, and transitions from clinical supply platforms to scaled commercial supply.
* Support business case development for strategic investments (redundant capacity, alternate sites, new technology platforms) and lead long-range capacity planning/modelling to ensure the network can support future portfolio growth, new indications, and evolving patient demand.
**6. Data, Systems & Analytics**
* Leading and enhancing performance management and visualization efforts, specifically improving dashboards that can be used across markets, supply, finance, and overall performance management
* Define the IBP technology vision with Digital/IT, including platforms for complex, low-volume, high-variability planning.
* Ensure data quality for critical demand, therapy, batch, expiry, and distribution attributes.
* Lead Data Analytics to develop advanced planning insights, improve forecast ability of ultra-small populations, and evaluate risk-based scenarios for proactive decision-making.
**7. Stakeholder Engagement & Change Leadership**
* Drive adoption of IBP behaviours in a highly cross-functional, mission-driven rare disease culture.
* Communicate clearly with senior leadership on risks, trade-offs, and opportunities, always emphasizing patient impact.
* Build planning capability across global and regional teams and mentor planners supporting rare disease products.
* Function as an internal expert and thought leader on best-practice IBP/S&OP for rare disease and biologics.
**KPIs & Metrics: This role will influence:**
* Patient & Service Metrics
* Supply Reliability Metrics
* Inventory & Waste Metrics
* Forecast & Financial Metrics
* IBP Process Health Metrics
**Qualifications**
**Required:**
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, Life Sciences, or related field.
* 12+ years of progressive supply chain or operations leadership in biotech, pharmaceutical, or rare disease environments.
* Proven leadership of global S&OP/IBP processes, including long-range capacity planning, inventory strategy, and executive decision support.
* Strong command of ERP, advanced planning systems, and analytics tools that support scenario modelling and business decisions.
* Demonstrated success leading through senior executives in complex, matrixed global organizations.
* Deep understanding of life science supply chains, including access variability, long lead times, biologics complexity, and patient-critical supply continuity.
* Strong financial acumen with proven cross-functional leadership in matrixed organizations.
**Preferred:**
* Master’s degree (MBA, MS, or equivalent).
* Experience with biologics, gene therapy, enzyme replacement therapies, or other complex rare disease modalities.
* APICS/ASCM, SCOR-P, or equivalent certification.
* Experience integrating clinical and commercial supply processes.
* Familiarity with global regulatory / GxP constraints uniquely impacting rare disease therapies.
**Core Competencies**
* **Patient-Centric Mindset** — prioritizes therapy availability for individuals with life-altering conditions.
* **Strategic Systems Thinking** — understands complex network interactions across clinical and commercial supply, including long-range capacity and inventory trade-offs.
* **Executive Influence** — builds alignment, shapes decisions, and leads cross-functional forums with credibility in complex matrix environments.
* **Data Analytics & Financial Acumen** — translates operational scenarios into financial and patient impacts using data-driven insights and advanced planning analytics.
* **Inventory Strategy** — balances service, waste, and working capital through thoughtful inventory policy, positioning, and risk management.
* **Risk Management** — proactive identification and mitigation of rare disease supply vulnerabilities.
* **Change Leadership** — able to embed new planning behaviours, tools, and processes in a global organization.
**Travel Requirements**
* International travel (10–25%) to manufacturing sites, affiliates, clinical hubs, and global planning workshops.

Lead Product Designer (UX/UI & Research)
London (Hybrid) | Contract | Start ASAP with potential for growth into our full time vacancy | Competitive salary
The role
We’re a well-funded startup building category-defining AI for architecture, engineering and construction: an archaic industry at a critical juncture. The Building Safety Act now requires firms to evidence their design decisions, and directors carry personal liability.
Join Bite as our first in-house designer, initially for a 6 month contract, but with the potential to grow into our full time vacancy. Working strategically and directly with the head of product, founders and engineering team, you’ll own the entire design function and lead the transformation of our beta into a high-quality user experience that shapes the future of Bite’s AI for the built environment.
Why join Bite
The problem is genuinely hard. When a structural engineer changes a component in their building design model, the same component exists in drawings, schedules, specs and emails under different names, in different formats, some of which LLMs don’t understand, and with no shared identifier. Detecting these changes, predicting the downstream impacts and propagating them using AI under the engineer's supervision is the core of our product.
You'll own the UX/UI for the whole product, not a slice of it. We're a small, agile, product-led team so if we need to pivot, we will prototype, test and build rapidly. You won’t find a feature factory or dependency delays here.
Your work ships to people who pay. The platform beta is in production with signed customers that include some of the UK's leading structural engineering firms who are keen to build with us. With our tight feedback loops, you’ll have plenty of data to help drive your design decisions.
What we're building
Structural engineers work across numerous, fragmented sets of tools with no shared source of truth. When a design changes, propagating that change across files is manual, slow and error-prone, and the errors are expensive.
Bite is the change management and audit trail layer for structural engineering. The platform does three things that today take weeks of manual work: natural-language search across a project's entire file ecosystem, cross-file impact detection e.g. "I changed Column C7 in the structural model - what drawings, schedules, and specs are now out of date?" and propagation of the detected changes to all affected files.
What you’ll do
Set the design direction for our products and raise the overall bar for craft and quality.
Establish and scale our design foundations, including the design system and UI patterns.
Shape the visual identity and brand across every customer touchpoint.
Partner with customers to shape product vision, design strategy, and the experience roadmap.
Collaborate with the head of product, founders and engineering team to define problems, explore solution spaces, validate concepts, ensure technical feasibility and ship product improvements that move the metrics that matter.
Analyse product performance to identify friction points and drive iterative optimisation, aligning business goals with user-centred product opportunities.
Lead comprehensive user research, including interviews, surveys, behavioural analysis, prototype testing, and usability studies, to identify user needs, confirm concepts, and produce actionable insights.
Translate insights, data, and business needs into user journeys, wireframes, prototypes and ultimately end-to-end, intuitive design solutions that drive meaningful improvements.
Facilitate workshops to build shared understanding and present design decisions clearly to influence strategic, experience-led discussions.
Encode the judgment and complexity required for complex workflows under the hood, while keeping the user experience simple and seamless.
Stay current on emerging AI trends and product patterns. Build a clear point of view on what matters, and bring that perspective into how we design at Bite.
What we need from you
A senior or lead product designer with 5+ years of experience (preferably shipping high-quality B2B products, with expertise in AI products).
An autonomous, opinionated builder who is comfortable being the sole designer and enjoys facilitating design sprints and principles within an engineering team.
A creative excited to work in a fast-paced startup environment.
A proven IC track record of expertise across UX/UI research, including interviews, surveys, usability testing, behavioural analysis, and the ability to translate insights into end-to-end digital experiences at scale.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and fluency in data, using qualitative and quantitative signals to validate design decisions, measure impact, and inform tradeoffs.
Demonstrated understanding of human-centred design principles and usability best practices, responsive design, product, technical, and business constraints in real-world environments.
Demonstrable ability to build intuitive, user-centred experiences supported by a portfolio showing strong interaction design foundation, high-quality visual craft and attention to detail, structured problem framing and systems thinking, advanced experience working with AI-native research, design, and collaboration tools and advanced proficiency in Figma, including component-based design systems, auto layout, variables, prototyping logic, and developer collaboration workflows (e.g., Dev Mode, structured handoff).
Evidence of shipping work that moved real business or operational metrics, and an ability to talk about those numbers fluently.
The ability to connect design decisions and rationale to user outcomes, articulating trade-offs and measurable business impact.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, concise, customer-ready documentation.
Ability to move fluidly between the big question (what should this experience do?) and the craft-level detail that makes high-stakes decisions feel simple.
Highly organised and adaptable, able to balance critical thinking with hands-on delivery, while contributing to the evolution of the design system and culture.
Experience working autonomously to design complex, multi-step product flows.
What you can expect from us
Fair and competitive salary
Flexible, hybrid working
Genuine ownership and an open and creative environment where you’ll help us define the future of Bite, what we work on and our culture
Passionate, growth-minded people with an entrepreneurial mindset and the confidence to operate autonomously within a fast-moving startup environment

Board Intelligence is a technology and advisory firm on a mission to make boards more effective, and through them, build better businesses and benefit society.
Over twenty years we have established ourselves as the market leader in governance and board effectiveness, trusted by more than 80,000 directors, executives, and governance professionals globally, including across the Fortune 500, FTSE 100, and OMX 30. That trust has been earned through depth of insight, rigorous advisory work, and a track record that newer entrants simply cannot replicate.

Our AI-powered platform and smart board advisor give us a competitive advantage that is widening, not narrowing. In 2024, K1 Investment Management, the leading B2B Enterprise SaaS investor, backed us to accelerate that position further. We are now growing fast, with a proven commercial model spanning both mid-market and enterprise, and a product suite that has become a necessary addition in high-stakes board environments.
The people joining us now will shape how we scale. We are deliberate about how we do that. Our founders and leadership team are deeply invested in keeping the culture that got us here: thoughtful, high calibre, and genuinely human. Ambition and balance are not in competition at Board Intelligence.
If you want to work at the intersection of AI and governance, on problems that matter at the highest level, this is a strong place to be.
Our Mission
We unleash the potential of organisations through the science of board effectiveness, building better businesses and benefitting society.
### **The Role**
Board Intelligence’s People & Culture function is moving from a single generalist role carrying everything to a set of focused specialisms. The People Advisor owns the operational core of that function: policy application, employee relations casework, compensation benchmarking and engagement.
The role exists to give managers and employees fast, reliable, day-to-day support on employment matters — from onboarding through to sensitive employee relations casework — without every query needing to travel up the chain. You will work closely with the People & AI Enablement Partner to keep delivery consistent as the AI enablement agenda reshapes how the function operates.
This is a hands-on role for someone who wants genuine ownership of cases from open to close, who reads employment law carefully, and who would rather build a manager’s confidence than quietly take the problem off their hands.
**Main Responsibilities**
* Manage employee relations, risk and compliance cases (probation, performance, grievance, disciplinary) end to end across the UK, with support to Sweden and Denmark, applying the right jurisdictional employment law and without escalating standard cases.
* Work with our ER lawyer in Sweden where Nordic matters require specialist input.
* Interpret people policies (probation, leave, flexible working) with judgement, escalating genuine ambiguity rather than defaulting every query upward.
* Keep policy documentation current and written in language managers can act on without needing it interpreted first.
* Own office safety compliance.
* Own compensation benchmarking, ensuring pay decisions are grounded in current market data rather than precedent.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, ensuring changes are accurate, on time and traceable.
* Share ownership of Career Pathways with the PX Advisor, ensuring career development conversations are consistent regardless of who is leading them.
* Own day-to-day employee engagement activity, turning survey themes into visible, practical action for managers and teams.
* Partner directly with line managers to build their confidence handling day-to-day people issues, reducing dependency on P&C for routine matters.
* Act as a visible culture champion across the London office.
**Person Specification**
This role suits an HR generalist who has already carried real casework on their own and wants the breadth of a specialist remit without losing the hands-on work. You are comfortable operating without a large support structure, confident making the calls that are yours to make, and clear about when a matter genuinely needs escalating.
You take the same care over benchmarking data and case documentation as you do over the conversations themselves, and your instinct with a manager is to build their capability rather than absorb their problem.
**Required Skills and Experience**
* 2 plus years’ generalist HR experience in a fast-moving SaaS or tech business, comfortable operating without a large support structure.
* Working knowledge of UK employment law, with the judgement to know what to check when you are not sure.
* Demonstrated ownership of ER casework end to end, not just involvement — running a case from open to close.
* Comfortable working with compensation and benchmarking data, not only relationships.
* Clear, precise written communication: policies and case notes that stand on their own without needing interpretation.
* Comfortable being a visible culture champion

* Exposure to Swedish or Danish employment law, given our Stockholm and Copenhagen footprint.
* Experience supporting employees across multiple jurisdictions or legal entities.
* CIPD qualification, or working towards one.
* Experience running or improving an engagement survey cycle end to end.
* Comfort using AI tooling to reduce administrative work in a people function.

* Standard ER cases are opened, run and closed by you, with escalation reserved for genuine complexity rather than volume.

Whether you're an early-career candidate exploring where your interests fit, or an experienced professional looking for your next challenge, you'll have the opportunity to develop skills across multiple cyber disciplines. You might find yourself analysing data, building software, developing investigative tradecraft, researching adversary behaviour, automating workflows, or creating new capabilities that help protect the UK's most critical organisations.

If you've ever been fascinated by how technology works, how cyber threats are uncovered, or how innovative tools can help solve difficult problems, there's a good chance you'll find a home here.

• Build tools and platforms that help cyber teams work more effectively. • Explore large and complex datasets to uncover valuable insights. • Develop automation and software that improves cyber operations. • Research emerging technologies, threats and analytical techniques. • Support investigations into sophisticated cyber activity. • Create new capabilities that help defend the UK's critical infrastructure and government organisations. • Collaborate with engineers, analysts, researchers and cyber specialists to solve challenging problems. • Continuously learn and adapt as technologies, threats and opportunities evolve.

**You might be a good fit if you've ever found yourself asking questions like**:
• How do cyber teams actually uncover threats? • How do the tools behind modern cyber investigations really work? • How do you build the technology that powers cyber investigations at scale? • How do software, data and cyber security all fit together? • How can we stay ahead of constantly evolving threats? • How can I turn curiosity into real-world impact? • How can I bring all my previous experience together into one impactful role? • How will cyber teams evolve and adapt to the AI-revolution?
**You don't need to have all the answers already. We're looking for people with curiosity, enthusiasm and a willingness to learn.**
## **Essential Skills / Experience**
**You don't need to be an expert in every area—we're looking for people who bring curiosity, potential and a genuine enthusiasm for technology and cyber security.**
• A strong interest in cyber security, technology and solving complex problems. • An analytical mindset with the ability to think logically and approach challenges in a structured way. • A willingness to learn new tools, technologies and ways of working across cyber, software and data disciplines. • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team. • A proactive approach to learning, continuous improvement and personal development. • An interest in understanding how technology, data and security can be used together to create meaningful outcomes. • A growth mindset and enthusiasm for tackling unfamiliar challenges. • Ability to obtain and maintain UK Developed Vetting (DV) security clearance.

## **About the role**
BT is entering a new phase of growth, moving from building infrastructure to unlocking value from it. As new products emerge across connectivity, data, platforms and AI, the ability to take innovation to market and scale it effectively is critical. This role sits at the centre of that challenge shaping how innovation happens across one of the UK's largest organisations.
You will join Etc., the innovation and incubation unit of BT. Etc. is a team of product, design, engineering and innovation specialists that work with BT’s Technology Units and Customer Facing Units to identify, develop and incubate new products and ventures. Organised around growth themes aligned to BT’s strategy, Etc. operates with a start-up mindset while leveraging BT’s scale and expertise in connectivity to develop innovative connectivity, data and developer solutions for BT’s priority verticals and customers. The team is also experimenting and incubating products in emerging markets such as drones, autonomous vehicles, robotics, physical AI, cyber and quantum security.
As the Innovation Strategy Manager, you will help BT identify where future growth will come from and accelerate the path from idea to commercial scale. You will shape innovation priorities, improve investment decisions, strengthen innovation portfolio performance, and help bring new products to market across areas such as drones, autonomous vehicles, data, platforms, cyber security, agentic AI and quantum technologies.
This is a highly collaborative role, working with cross-functional innovation squads comprising product, design, engineering, growth, marketing, commercial and delivery teams within Etc. and across BT. You will also build strong relationships with leaders and teams across BT's Technology Units and Customer Facing Units, aligning priorities and driving execution of innovation initiatives.
This is a hands-on strategy role with a strong commercial and operational focus and bias for action. You will lead initiatives from concept through to implementation, shaping strategy, developing business cases, influencing investment decisions and ensuring delivery of measurable business outcomes. Success requires the ability to navigate ambiguity, balance strategic thinking with practical execution, and drive progress across multiple priorities simultaneously.
You will thrive in a fast-paced environment, using influence rather than authority to bring teams together, remove barriers and accelerate the development, launch and scaling of innovative products and capabilities. Acting as a force multiplier, you will enable others to deliver at pace while increasing the overall effectiveness of BT's innovation ecosystem.

**Portfolio and Investment Performance**

StratOps team as they design, test and scale new innovation capabilities in Etc. and across BT including embedding the innovation operating model, new funding models, ideas platform roll-out, product-led ways-of-working, fit-for-purpose corporate processes, and adoption of innovation tools.

Position title: Project Manager, Strategic and Co-Chair Communications

This means that our employees are paid the same salary according to their grade and location. Term: Indefinite contract
Background C40 is a network of nearly 100 mayors of the world’s leading cities, who are working to deliver the urgent action needed right now to confront the climate crisis, and create a future where everyone, everywhere can thrive. Mayors of C40 cities are committed to using a science-based and people-focused approach to help the world limit global heating to 1.5°C and build healthy, equitable and resilient communities. Through a Global Green New Deal, mayors are working alongside a broad coalition of representatives from labour, business, the youth climate movement and civil society to go further and faster than ever before.
Our international staff work with the C40 network under the leadership of city governments to deliver this mission. Using a data-driven approach, our team identifies and promotes the exchange of proven programmes and policies developed by cities; provides world-class research, technical expertise and access to key partners to deliver new programmes and policies with cities; and communicates cities’ individual achievements and collective leadership.
Diversity Statement
C40 is committed to supporting and promoting equity and diversity and creating an inclusive working environment for everyone. We believe that when people with different life experiences are involved in decision-making, we deliver better. We believe having a diverse workforce ensures we connect better with all the different communities and people affected by the climate crisis. This enables us to make better decisions which lead to better outcomes in the work we do through increased creativity, productivity, greater global impact alongside a broader perspective and approach to our work.
We welcome applicants that are diverse in terms of age, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, ethnicity and perspective. Our goal is for C40 to be an environment where everyone, from any background, can flourish and can be themselves whilst contributing to our mission. If you identify as a person with a disability, we work to provide reasonable appropriate measures and any additional support needed to provide an equitable working experience. If you are living with a disability, chronic illness or neurodiversity please inform us, to provide you with the proper assistance in the application process.
C40 promotes a work culture where staff can input to improve equity, diversity and inclusion through staff-led groups and formal forums. We know that creating our ideal working environment is a learning process and we are committed to the ongoing effort. Department Description:
The C40 Communications team is responsible for strategically positioning C40 as one of the world’s most impactful climate organisations by celebrating the ambitious, equitable action underway in C40 cities and establishing our mayors as global leaders of the climate movement. Through our global communications we aim to shift the narrative and inspire real progress on the greatest challenge humanity is facing today.
Position Description:
This role will be at the heart of C40’s communications team. The role will support the Director to undertake various exciting activities including co-leading on strategic communications, media and partnerships creating and executing communications activities, ensuring the delivery of key communications projects with other C40 teams and providing specific support to the Co-Chair’s communications.
The post holder will co-lead and undertake strategic communications activities and lead on special projects related to strategic communications work which advance climate change action all around the world.
Responsibilities:
Strategic Communications
* Support the delivery of strategic communications plans for key organisational priorities and milestones, including drafting first versions of communications plans under the direction of the Director of Strategic Communications, Media and Partnerships. Coordinate the implementation of communications plans, tracking deliverables, timelines, dependencies and progress to ensure timely and effective execution.
* Monitor the delivery and impact of communications activities, identifying opportunities to strengthen execution and improve outcomes.
* Support the delivery of strategic communications for the Breathe Cities programme, working under the guidance of the team Director.
* Support the Director in the coordination, management and growth of the Communications Network, helping to maintain strong relationships with members and ensure ongoing engagement.
* Support the planning and delivery of network convenings, including but not limited to project coordination, agenda development, coordinating presentations, logistics and speaker briefings.
* Coordinate follow-up activities after network convenings, including tracking actions, sharing resources and maintaining member engagement.
* Maintain network records, contact lists and engagement trackers, ensuring accurate information and effective relationship management.
* Support broader communications planning and cross-team coordination, helping ensure alignment across organisational priorities.
* Draft and edit communications content e.g. key messages, press releases, statements, emails.
* And any other duties appropriate for the grade.
Co-Chair Communications
* Support the Director in integrating Co-Chair communications workplans, priorities and objectives into the organisation's wider milestone communications planning and strategy.
* Maintain forward planning and coordination for Co-Chair communications activities, ensuring visibility of upcoming engagements, global events, announcements and communications opportunities.
Project Management
* Lead and maintain the administrative systems, workflows and processes that support the Strategic Communications, Media and Partnerships team.
* Coordinate project plans, meeting schedules, action trackers and reporting for team projects to ensure effective delivery across multiple workstreams.
* Attend key internal and external meetings, providing coordination support to the Director of Strategic Communications, Media and Partnerships, including documenting decisions, tracking follow-up actions and monitoring delivery against agreed commitments.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with internal teams and external partners to facilitate effective collaboration and delivery of communications objectives.
* And any other duties appropriate for the grade
Person Specification:
The post holder will be experienced in project management and have a background in communications, including: * Strong experience in communications and project management.
* Experience drafting key messages, press releases and other communications materials.
* Experience managing a wide range of projects, navigating complex stakeholder relationships/ high profile stakeholders.
* Experience in a range of topics and ability to learn and dive deep into new topics quickly.
* Excellent organisational skills and detail-oriented.
* Delivery-oriented, with problem-solving and strategic thinking capabilities and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Demonstrated ability working with diverse cultures from around the world.
* Interested in a long-term career in working internationally on climate change in a global organisation.
* Strong English language skills.
* Ability to speak other languages is desirable.
Other Requirements:
Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Moderate travel will be required as part of the role. We seek to recruit individuals who not only have the appropriate skills and experience for the role, but are committed to carrying out their roles in line with our organisational values.
C40 offers a comprehensive benefits package to support employee well-being and work-life balance:
* Paid Time Off: Full-time employees receive 35 days of paid time off annually, which includes all national holidays.
* Company Shutdowns: In addition to the standard paid time off, C40 provides two non-contractual, non-statutory shutdown weeks each year (mid-year and end-of-year) for a full break.

The CHANEL Brand is one of the most important assets of our House. Protecting our Intellectual Property is fundamental to preserving the brand’s equity, exclusivity, desirability and long-term competitive advantage. In the context of technological innovation, complex new digital platforms, AI and macro-economic changes which continue to transform business models, effective IP protection requires a combination of strategic vision, legal expertise, transformational leadership and critical innovative skills.
Chanel is deeply committed to protecting its intellectual property and combating counterfeits and infringements. The fight against counterfeiting goes beyond the mere protection of our brand image: it is also a matter of protecting consumers from products that may be a health hazard and who, in most cases, are deceived about their quality and authenticity.
## Your role @ CHANEL
The UK Regional Head of Intellectual Property is responsible for developing and implementing the company’s Global intellectual property strategy within their region (including UK, Canada, Australia, South Africa), including the protection, enforcement, and commercialisation of its IP assets. This encompasses balancing strategic planning with practical execution, budget management, advocacy and representation, business support, team management and leadership, and overseeing the implementation of AI and other new technology and innovation. The role also carries primary responsibility for liaison with and escalation to the UK Region General Counsel on UK Region IP and Brand Protection activity.
This role requires a strategic and forward-looking leader managing strong and decisive brand protection, and anti-counterfeiting activities. The successful candidate will bring a business-critical perspective to IP, ensuring that intellectual property protection supports and enables the House’s long-term growth, brand equity, and competitive advantage.
This role will require a leader who can balance the demands of strengthening, maintaining and enforcing a world-class IP portfolio while ensuring effective resource allocation and sound budget management. The successful candidate will leverage technology, data and innovative AI tools to enhance the effectiveness and impact of the IP function, enabling the team to focus on higher-value activities and future challenges.
This role will also require maximising and protecting the House’s brand equity, identifying opportunities to streamline processes, improve ways of working and drive AI innovation across the function. It will also contribute to elevating and developing the capabilities of the regional and global IP community, fostering a collaborative, high-performing and forward-looking team equipped to meet the evolving needs of the business.
The successful candidate will be a strong, transformational and inspiring leader, with high emotional intelligence, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable with driving change, engaging and influencing senior business leaders, translating complex IP matters into clear, actionable insights, and providing regular updates and strategic recommendation to UK leadership. This will include expertise in the rapidly evolving intersection of AI and IP, with the ability to assess emerging legal, regulatory and litigation risks and providing strategic advice on the protection, enforcement and exploitation of IP rights in an AI-driven environment.
The Regional Head of IP will be a solicitor, barrister, trade mark attorney or equivalent and have 10+ years of experience and will work closely across divisions and functions and with the Global and other IP regional teams. As a member of the IP Steerco, the role holder will regularly input into Global IP strategies to align with the legal team’s wider collective priorities in establishing decisive brand leadership.
They will work as one team with the other members of the IP Steerco, keeping the Steerco abreast of all progress, adaptations, challenges and successes in the region to ensure the region’s IP portfolio is consistent with and supports the Global and regional business objectives.
## What impact can you create at CHANEL
### IP Strategy and Management
* Develop, implement and deliver a comprehensive IP strategy aligned with the company’s business goals.
* Manage and oversee the company’s regional IP portfolio, including trade marks, copyrights, trade secrets, trade dress and domain names.
* Identify and protect new intellectual property opportunities, including non-traditional forms of protection.
* Coordinate regional and global IP protection strategies in partnership with global IP leadership.
* Drive policy, process, initiatives and efficiencies that support best practice.
* Manage IP and anti-counterfeiting budgets with full accountability.
### Legal Compliance and Enforcement
* Ensure compliance with all relevant IP laws and regulations.
* Oversee and act as the point of escalation for any contentious IP matters including:
+ Cease-and-desist actions
+ Trade mark oppositions and cancellations
+ Online and offline enforcement
+ Investigations
* Take direct responsibility for high-profile and strategic IP disputes and litigation, leading enforcement efforts from initial assessment through to resolution.
* Anticipate disputes, execute risk mitigation, and manage effective strategic litigation where necessary.
* Drive the IP related advocacy efforts in collaboration with the Public Affairs team.
### Brand Protection
* Build, manage and expand portfolios that provide value and protect innovation.
* Develop innovative solutions to mitigate brand protection risks.
* Coordinate with global anti-counterfeiting, anti-diversion and enforcement teams.
* Create and execute regional enforcement priorities.
* Engage with industry groups, regulators, law enforcement, customs authorities and external organisations on strategic IP issues.
### Team Leadership and Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of trade mark attorneys and paralegals.
* Foster a culture of AI adoption, innovation and continuous improvement within the IP team.
* Contribute to and maintain positive working relationships, fostering a cohesive, committed team environment which drives effective partnerships across all divisions and functions.
### Education and Advocacy
* Report on IP activity and strategy to the UK General Counsel, UK Region Leadership and Global IP team.
* Educate internal stakeholders on IP matters and the importance of IP protection.
* Advance the company’s IP interests by partnering with our Public Affairs team to influence policy developments, coordinate consultation responses and represent the business in industry groups and external forums.
## Current Strategic Focus Areas
The Global IP Priorities are currently focused on:
* Anti-counterfeiting enforcement
* Online and offline infringement actions
* Anti-diversion and grey-market controls
* Expansion of non-conventional trade mark, copyright, patent and trade dress protection
* Use of new technologies and enforcement tools
* Cross-border and platform-based enforcement strategies
## ## You are energised by:
* Leading a high-performing team, driving continuous improvement and change through process optimisation, innovation and tech as well as the effective development and adoption of AI.
* Thinking out of the box, proposing innovative and creative solutions.
* Taking a proactive and self-motivated approach with a strong sense of integrity.
* Detail-orientation and highly organised.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Using your strong interpersonal skills with the ability to counsel and influence on IP risks and other IP matters across all levels of the organisation.
* Working collaboratively across regions and with cross-functional teams.
* Contributing to the on-going and company-wide version of sustainability. Sustainability is one of CHANEL’s key performance drivers, embedded into our ways of working and we require continued collective action from all employees to deliver on CHANEL’s House Sustainability Ambitions across our four key areas:
+ Restoring Nature and Climate
+ Investing in Circularity
+ Advancing dignity and prosperity
+ Promoting the autonomy of women
## What you will bring to the team
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in intellectual property law, with significant in-house experience. Additional commercial law experience is strongly preferred.
* An English qualified solicitor, barrister or trade mark attorney or equivalent in the UK with a specialisation in IP law.
* Experienced user of IP portfolio management tech and a strong and experienced advocate of AI adoption.
* Proven track record in developing and executing IP strategies.
* Experience in managing global IP portfolios and leading IP litigation.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Excellent leadership towards internal and external stakeholders and team management abilities.
* Strong business acumen and understanding of the commercial aspects of IP.
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills.
* Able to advise on emerging IP issues to ensure innovative and cutting-edge approaches.
## What you can gain from this experience
* The opportunity to play a pivotal role in protecting and strengthening one of the world’s most distinctive luxury brands, contributing to CHANEL’s long-term brand equity and reputation.
* A highly collaborative, international environment, working closely with regional and global legal, IP, brand protection and business teams.
* Meaningful leadership responsibility, with the opportunity to shape regional IP strategy, develop a high-performing team and influence global priorities.
* A culture that supports personal growth, learning and career development, encouraging you to be at your best and to create impact through your expertise.
* An inclusive working environment that values different perspectives, experiences and strengths, and recognises the uniqueness each person brings to CHANEL.
* The UK Region plays a pivotal role in delivering CHANEL’s House Sustainability Ambitions. Transforming our business and leaving a lasting positive impact on people and the planet will require the collaborative efforts of everyone across our House. As an employee of CHANEL, you will be an important part of this journey.

Our employee benefits have been created to support you across your professional and personal life by offering you:
* Physical Wellbeing: private medical insurance covering pre-existing medical conditions and ability to add family members, online GP App with 24/7 appointments available within 24 hours and cycle scheme participation for a tax-exempt bike and/or accessories
* Financial Wellbeing: pension, life assurance and retail discounts across multiple retailers including supermarkets, gyms, days out and 100’s more

Quality is central to everything we do — and as we invest in our digital quality management infrastructure, we are looking for the right person to own and drive it.
**The Role**
This is not a standard inspection role. As Quality Systems Engineer, you will be responsible for Colloide's digital quality management system — developing ITP libraries, designing and configuring inspection workflows in Procore, managing quality gates, producing dashboards and KPI reporting, standardising inspection forms across all product lines, and training staff to ensure consistent adoption across all sites.
Alongside the digital systems remit, you will provide hands-on quality assurance across the full project lifecycle — from design review and incoming goods through to fabrication, assembly, testing, and Factory Acceptance. You will work closely with our Design, Engineering, Project Management, Procurement, and Production teams to embed quality at every stage.
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Assurance — Full Project Lifecycle**
• Participate in design reviews and ensure project-specific ITPs are configured and approved within Procore before production commences.
• Engage with Project Managers from kick-off, reviewing client specifications and building quality requirements into each project programme.
• Manage incoming goods inspections, material certification checks, and supplier NCR processes.
• Carry out in-process quality inspections throughout fabrication and assembly, maintaining quality gate checkpoints at each workstation.
• Plan, coordinate, and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including client-witnessed inspections, with all records managed within Procore.
• Raise and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), lead root cause investigations using 5 Whys, Fishbone or FMEA, and ensure corrective actions are implemented and verified.
• Support internal and external audits including ISO 9001 surveillance and water authority inspections.
**Digital Quality Management (Procore)**
• Develop, maintain and continuously improve standard ITP templates within Procore for all major product lines.
• Configure and administer quality workflows within Procore including inspections, hold points, approvals, observations, defects, and close-out processes.
• Develop digital inspection forms, quality checklists and testing records to standardise quality assurance across all projects.
• Monitor inspection and testing completion through Procore dashboards, ensuring quality gates are not bypassed before work progresses.
• Produce digital quality reports and live KPI dashboards from Procore, covering inspection status, NCR trends, outstanding actions and overall project quality performance.
• Act as system owner for Procore Quality Management, driving consistent adoption across all business units and sites.
• Provide training and ongoing support to staff in the effective use of Procore quality tools.
• Support the development of integrated quality processes linking Procore with ERP systems, document control and product serialisation initiatives.
**Reporting & Continuous Improvement**
• Generate weekly quality reports and live dashboards covering inspection completion, quality gates, NCR status, and corrective actions.
• Analyse quality data and NCR trends to identify and drive improvement across all product lines and processes.
• Contribute to Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives across the business.
