**The Role:**
The Stirlingshire Monitoring and Control Officer (MCO) will contribute to the protection of the Highland Line (HL), a coast-to-coast control zone which aims to prevent grey squirrels from moving north from Central Scotland into the red strongholds of the Highlands and Grampians. Progressed through a programme of targeted grey squirrel monitoring and control, you’ll help support the protection and expansion of red squirrel populations in accordance with the Saving Scotland’s Red Squirrels strategy. This role requires an approachable individual with experience in mammal control work that enjoys working outdoors and interacting with people.
**Main objectives:**
Delivering responsive and strategic grey squirrel control in the region primarily from the shores and islands of Loch Lomond, heading east to Callander and the Teith Valley to Doune; develop regional Rapid Response Monitoring networks in the region; recruit and train volunteers and external partners in grey squirrel control and monitoring; build relations with local landowners and stakeholders; and support the Argyll and West Dumbartonshire MCO with removal of grey squirrels from the Loch Lomond islands.
**This includes:**
* Carry out responsive and strategic grey squirrel control through trapping in priority areas
* Plan and support the development and expansion of a regional Rapid Response Monitoring (RRM) networks
* Assist with recruiting and provide appropriate training to volunteers and external partners in grey squirrel control, monitoring and detection methods
* Where required, carry out Operational Monitoring (OM) to assess squirrel presence e.g. feeder boxes and/or camera traps
* Monitor the spread of the squirrel pox virus through the Central Lowlands by carrying out trapping and testing in sampling survey squares
* Collect and maintain records on monitoring and trapping efforts using Excel, ArcGIS and the SSRS Hub (database) and contribute to reporting on project performance.
* Encourage interest in local red squirrel conservation with relevant local communities, landowners and stakeholders through media and events
* Support the Argyll and West Dumbartonshire MCO with the removal of grey squirrels from the Loch Lomond Islands through trapping and targeted shooting
**The successful candidate will ideally have:**
* A degree or equivalent qualification in ecology, countryside management or related discipline.
* A minimum two years’ experience in a relevant field, including practical wildlife management/ invasive non-native species control.
* Experience in collecting, maintaining and reporting standardised ecological data.
* Experience of working with landowners, gamekeepers, foresters and the public.
* Experience recruiting, training and supporting volunteers to undertake active conservation work.
* A good understanding of conservation principles, practices and legislation.
* Knowledge of native tree species and familiarity with the Trossachs and Stirlingshire area (advantageous).
* Willingness to occasionally work out of normal working hours.
* A full clean driving licence.
* Possess, or be willing and eligible to obtain, a Firearms licence.

Sales - London, Greater London (Hybrid)

Senior Account Executive
Some senior AEs are at their best working on a packed pipeline; sharp on qualification, fast to build rapport, curious with discovery, relentless on follow-through. Others are at their best hunting: building their own pipeline from scratch, crafting outbound that engages decision leaders, creating opportunities where none existed.
The ones who do both and consistently, in the same role, quarter after quarter are rare. If that sounds like you, this might be exactly the right next step.
Are you ready to sell something that genuinely matters?
At Semble, we're transforming healthcare professionals with our clinical system. Already trusted by thousands of groups, and used in the care of millions of patients, we're the UK market leader in private primary care and the fastest-growing practice management software provider. Backed by leading investors, we're scaling rapidly, and we need an exceptional Senior Account Executive to help us deliver the mid-market.
Location
This is a London-based hybrid role. We expect two days per week in our London office, with flexibility for the rest. You should be comfortable with regular customer visits across the UK as part of a normal working week.
The role
As a Senior Account Executive at Semble, you will own the full sales cycle for mid-market accounts: typically, £16k–80k ACV deals with 30–90 day cycles, often involving multiple stakeholders across clinical, operational, and financial functions. You'll work a balanced pipeline, converting well-qualified inbound leads while building your own book of outreach in parallel. Both matter.
New ARR is your primary metric. You'll report to our Commercial Lead and join a team that's growing in capability alongside a product that's growing in scope. The accounts you win today become some of Semble's most important relationships tomorrow
What you'll own
* Your pipeline, not just your inbound queue: A healthy, self-built pipeline that doesn't depend on a single source. You treat inbound as acceleration, not the only route to quota.
* The full cycle, front to back: From first contact through discovery, solution design, commercial negotiation, and close. You run the deal and take a problem-solving approach to progressing opportunities through the buying process.
* Multi-stakeholder deals, managed with intent: You map who holds the budget, who holds the veto, and who needs to see value before anyone else moves.
* Forecast integrity: A pipeline you can defend. Accurately staged, correctly qualified, with clear next steps on every active opportunity.
* Discovery that actually changes the deal: The ability to surface problems a prospect hasn't yet put into words — and connect Semble to business outcomes that matter to the people in the room.
What you'll bring
A track record at the mid-market level: 5+ years of B2B SaaS closing experience, with evidence of consistent performance against quota. You've closed deals in the £20k–100k ACV range involving multiple stakeholders.
Self-sourced pipeline alongside inbound conversion: You can point to a specific period where a meaningful share of your closed ARR came from opportunities you created yourself. Outbound is part of how you run your territory, not what you do when inbound dries up.
Qualification discipline: You qualify hard and exit fast when the fit isn't right. Your pipeline reflects reality because you've learned that a bloated pipeline is a management problem, not a safety net. Proficiency with a formal sales methodology (SPICED, MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, Sandler, etc)
Commercial craft: You've co-authored business cases that actually got presented to the economic buyer - documents you built alongside your champion, shaped around the language and priorities of the person in the room who holds the budget. You can point to specific deals where a well-constructed business case was the difference between a decision and a delay.
Multi-stakeholder deal management: You've navigated deals where the economic buyer, champion, and technical decision-maker were three different people. You know how to progress the deal across all of them simultaneously without losing control of the timeline.
Strong discovery instincts: Genuine curiosity underpins your approach to conversation, and you master the ability to reframe prospect’s problems.
AI and CRM fluency: Proficient in CRM & AI tools. A builder's mindset; you are comfortable creating structure (with Claude, Open AI, or equivalent) and process in an environment that is still maturing.
Bonus points for: Experience selling into the UK private healthcare market, or a background in health-tech or clinical systems.
Why join Semble?
* Sell something with a real mission: We're genuinely changing how private healthcare is delivered in the UK. That makes the sales conversation easier and the work more meaningful.
* A product that wins on merit: This ‘must have’ SaaS technology, customers choose Semble due to its impact on operational and clinical efficiency so they can focus on what matters; their patients.
* A team that's growing: Join at a point where the deals you win, and the way you operate will genuinely shape what the sales function looks like at scale.
What you'll get in return
* *The great feeling that comes with knowing you do something that matters*
* *Autonomy and ownership* *– we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!*

* *Work alongside an inspiring team* *– our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.*
* *Fantastic office space in Central London**, right outside Monument - with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!*
* *The usual free bits coming with nice offices* *(barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities...).*

We also encourage applications from disabled and neurodiverse candidates, so if there are any adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process, please do let us know.*

# Senior/Staff Subsystem & SoC Design Engineer

**Arm**

Additionally, you will work with the verification team to review test plans and help debug design issues and the implementation team to optimise those designs. You will plan your work, provide tracking and report status in order to ensure high-quality and timely delivery.

JOB SUMMARY
Semtech is a leading supplier of high-performance analog and mixed-signal semiconductors powering high-speed optical interconnects for hyperscale and AI data center networks, enterprise networking, wireless infrastructure, and passive optical access networks. The successful product definition engineer has deep technical credibility both inside and outside of Semtech, as well as good analytical and communication skills; and plays a critical leadership role as an interface between product marketing and engineering teams, defining technical requirements, performance targets, and features for our next-generation IC products.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
(40%) Product Definition for Next-generation High-Speed IC Products
Interface with customers and component partners to understand system and interconnect technical requirements, and distill these down to IC-level specs, in the form of detailed product requirements documents. Collaborate with analog, digital, and mechanical engineering teams and product management to work through design tradeoffs and feasibility analysis. Refine and iterate with engineering to improve designs and optimize requirements throughout the development and NPI process based on measured data, simulations, and customer feedback. Perform optical link analysis and simulation to support requirements definition and inform key parameter targets and tradeoffs
(25%) Optical Component and System Ecosystem Engagement
Drive Semtech’s technical engagement with the broader optical component and system equipment vendor ecosystem. Build and maintain strategic relationships with PIC vendors, laser and photodiode suppliers, host silicon providers to ensure technical compatibility, interoperability, and roadmap alignment.Work with optical module and system architects, platform SI engineers, and other key network hardware partners to align on requirements and roadmap.
(15%) Customer Technical Evangelism
Engage directly with customer engineers and end users as a subject matter expert to communicate key aspects of Semtech technology, product performance, and technical value proposition, and compare notes on industry technical direction.
(15%) Industry Standards and MSA Engagement
Lead Semtech’s active participation in the industry standards bodies that define the next generation of high-speed interconnect applications. Work with product definition peers and applications engineering teams to drive technical contributions to optical and electrical standards, MSA groups, and related forums to influence specification direction, build external credibility with peer companies, and translate standards activity into actionable product roadmap and NPI guidance.
(5%) Represent Semtech at Conferences & Customer Events
Engage with key strategic customers and ecosystem partners at major industry conferences (DesignCon, OFC, CIOE, ECOC, OCP, and/or similar), and give technical papers or presentations as appropriate to promote Semtech technology and market position.
MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optical Engineering, or other relevant field
8+ years of progressive hands-on technical experience in relevant engineering disciplines including high-speed analog and mixed signal circuit design and validation, optical components and transceivers, and/or physical layer networking.
Deep expertise in signal integrity, signal equalization techniques, optical link budgets, and analog/mixed-signal system requirements for high-speed broadband communications applications, including both direct-detect and coherent optical transmission. Appreciation of IC layout concepts, device models, and the effects of parasitics and other non-idealities on high-speed circuit performance.
Experience engaging with optical component vendors (PIC, photodiode, or module suppliers) in a design, system-level integration, co-development, and/or ecosystem partnership capacity.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
Effective verbal and written communication skills; able to engage credibly with IC design engineers, customer technical teams, and industry peers. Good judgment when communicating externally with customers
Team player able to work smoothly across functional teams, build trust, credibility and influence with key internal stakeholders, and work collaboratively to achieve goals without needing direct positional authority to do it. Able and willing to provide help and support outside of direct area of responsibility as needed
Comfortable working across global time zones; experience collaborating cross-functionally in a global team environment.
Self-starter able to operate in a dynamic, sometimes ambiguous environment, make key decisions based on partial data when needed, and manage risks and unknowns
DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS
Advanced degree (MSc, MEng, PhD) in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optical Engineering, or a related discipline
Direct prior experience in analog and mixed signal circuit design and IC development for high-speed communications systems
Direct prior experience designing and developing active optical components (lasers, PICs, PDs), optical transceivers, and/or high-speed networking systems (switches, routers, NICs, etc.). Experience with coherent optical component, transceiver, and/or system development highly desired.
Understanding of linear and non-linear channel simulation techniques; experience with circuit and system modeling software such as ADS, HFSS, and Matlab
Demonstrated participation in industry standards activities (IEEE 802.3, OIF, MSA groups, or equivalent)
Understanding of circuit fundamentals of key analog building blocks such as bias circuits, opamps, analog filters, CML logic, ADC and DACs using CMOS and/or BiCMOS technologies, and knowledge of more advanced circuits such as VCOs and closed-loop systems such as PLLs and clock and data recovery circuits
Experience with semiconductor and optical packaging technologies, and manufacturing assembly and fabrication processes for ICs, PCBs, optical transceivers, and/or high-speed copper cables
Hands-on experience with lab equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, optical power meters, sampling and real-time oscilloscopes, etc.
TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS
This role is expected to include a minimum of once-per-quarter travel, with frequency varying based on business priorities. Travel may include customer visits, industry tradeshows and conferences (DesignCon, OFC, CIOE, ECOC, OCP, and similar), and visits to Semtech sites across the US, Canada, and UK. Candidates should be comfortable with both domestic and international travel.

Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
Work within a dedicated product team
Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base

Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction

Experience with Fastlane
SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID

An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry

job_title: Member of Technical Staff - Software Engineer
job_description:
Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup based in London, founded by Guy Podjarny. We’ve raised over $100M from world-class investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV, and Boldstart, and in 2025 we were ranked #2 in Sifted EU’s B2B SaaS Rising 100 and #20 in Sifted's AI 100.
At Tessl, we are building the context layer for AI coding agents, and a platform for AI-native software development. As an early member of the team, you’ll help shape how we build, scale and support a company operating at the edge of AI and software development.
Overview of role
Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.
As a Software Engineer, you’ll be versatile and independent, excited to work with cutting-edge AI tools to build great products. We move quickly, but with purpose - balancing speed with collaboration and thoughtful execution. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, and the wider Engineering team to bring AI Native development to life in a fast-paced, high-trust environment.
What you’ll do
No two days will be the same at Tessl! You’ll have a high level of autonomy and be able to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here’s an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:
Design and implement new functionality that you discussed and reviewed with the product team
Spin up a proof of concept to showcase an innovative idea you’ve been thinking about
Rapidly prototype a new language integration for our code generation pipeline, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation.
Pair with a designer to fine-tune interactions in the UI, CLI or existing AI coding agents, making the user experience more intuitive and slick
Integrate a third-party service, e.g. for notifications, so we can focus our own cycles on Tessl’s core capabilities
Collaborate with other teams to plan an architecture that supports collaboration across the platform
Establish an end-to-end testing strategy to increase our confidence when deploying new features to production
Share your technical vision for a new product capability you’ll be leading with the wider engineering team for feedback and alignment
What we’re looking for
Essential
Proven experience (typically 5+ years or equivalent) as a Software Engineer. You care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics and have firsthand experience in how software is built across teams and environments
Equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove/disprove an assumption
Proven experience leveraging the best AI coding tools and agents to accelerate and enhance your own work and efficiency
Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you’ve ideally thrived in an early-stage startup before
You have demonstrated usage of AI tools in your day-to-day work, and be excited about experimenting, learning, and harnessing the potential of new AI tools and approaches to transform software engineering
Nice to have
Background in AI products or developer tools
Experience in rapid prototyping environments
Programming polyglot experienced in several languages of different paradigms (e.g.: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C or C++, Haskell, etc.)
Experience collaborating with AI researchers and bridging between research-focused and engineering-focused teams
Experience building & scaling REST APIs, particularly those conforming to JSON:API
Comfortable working on infrastructure (e.g., setting up CI pipelines, navigating Kubernetes)
If you have a personal or open-source project you’d like to share, we’d love to see it (GitHub links welcome!)
Salary and benefits
Office: Our brand new 10,000 sq. ft office is in the AI hub of Kings Cross, London. We have generous catering and have regular social events such as team lunches, drinks and more. We require all staff to be in our London HQ at least 3 days a week on our anchor days of Monday, Tuesday and Thursday.
Salary: We offer a competitive salary based on experience and skills, benchmarked against industry standards. Benefits: 25 days holiday, health insurance, including dental and vision, which extends to partners and dependents, as well as a company-matched pension. We also provide a commuting stipend for those who live outside London, and a cycle to work scheme.
Application Process
Here’s an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:
Introductory Call
Take-Home Exercise
On-site Technical Session
Culture Conversation Leadership Discussion Throughout the process, if you have any specific requirements or need adjustments, please let us know: we’re happy to accommodate.
We care deeply about the warm, inclusive environment we’re building at Tessl and we value diversity – we welcome applications from those typically underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this role but are not totally sure whether you’re the right person, do apply anyway!

From Manchester to New York, we're powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.
**Life at THG Beauty**
We know that beauty isn't one-size-fits-all. Our portfolio of leading retailers and iconic beauty brands caters to everyone, everywhere, empowering customers all over the world to look and feel fantastic.
By combining our portfolio of owned brands inclusive of ESPA, Ameliorate and Christophe Robin, with a marketplace for over 1,300 third-party beauty brands through online retail sites LOOKFANTASTIC, Cult Beauty, and Dermstore, THG Beauty's ambition is to be the global digital partner of choice across the beauty industry, supporting the channel shift to online.
THG Beauty's breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry's digital strategic leader.
**About Cult Beauty**
Cult Beauty is one of the UK's leading online beauty destinations, known for a curated, expert-led edit of the best emerging and established beauty brands. As part of THG, Cult Beauty combines an entrepreneurial, fast-moving culture with the scale, data and technology of a global e-commerce group. The affiliates and partnerships channel is a genuine growth priority for the business, with strong performance to date and significant headroom to scale reach, revenue and brand awareness over the next 12-24 months.
We're looking for a Senior Affiliates & Partnerships Manager to take ownership of Cult Beauty's affiliate channel and lead its next phase of growth. This is a hands-on role; you'll set the strategy and own the numbers. You will also be in the detail, planning activations, negotiating placements, managing budgets in real time, and reporting on performance. It suits someone who is equally comfortable building a forecast model as they are briefing a publisher or optimising a live campaign.
You'll own the channel's budget end-to-end, from annual and quarterly planning and forecasting through to in-month tracking, reforecasting and reconciliation against actuals, while also executing the campaigns and activations that bring the strategy to life. You'll use data, including media mix modelling (MMM) and other cross-channel measurement, to understand the channel's true incremental contribution and its role in the wider marketing mix, and you'll look for opportunities for the channel to support broader brand awareness goals, not just direct performance.
**As *Senior Affiliates & Partnerships Manager* you'll:**
**Channel strategy & scale**
* Own the affiliate and partnerships strategy for Cult Beauty, identifying and prioritising the highest-value opportunities to scale reach, revenue and new customer acquisition.
* Build the channel out from its current base, expanding the partner mix across content, cashback, loyalty, influencer-affiliate and technology partners, while protecting margin and brand value.
* Identify and develop opportunities for the channel to support wider brand awareness objectives, working with brand and content teams to use partnerships (e.g. content, video and influencer-affiliate placements) to build reach and consideration alongside direct performance.
* Keep the channel's commercial model, commission structure and partner tiering under continuous review, benchmarking against market practice.
**Budget planning, forecasting & management**
* Lead annual and quarterly budget planning and revenue/commission forecasting for the channel, working closely with finance and the wider marketing leadership team.
* Own in-month budget management and pacing, tracking spend and commission against forecast, reforecasting as needed, and flagging variances before they become a problem.
* Build and maintain robust forecasting models that link activity, seasonality and commercial terms to expected return, and use these to make the case for investment.
* Apply media mix modelling (MMM) outputs and other cross-channel measurement to inform budget allocation, understand the channel's incremental contribution, and stress-test planning assumptions against the wider marketing mix.
* Reconcile monthly performance against budget and finance records, ensuring accurate, timely reporting on channel P&L.
**Activation execution & campaign management**
* Plan and execute the affiliate activation calendar, from always-on placements through to peak trading moments (e.g. Black Friday, Cyber Monday, key beauty launches) and brand awareness activity.
* Brief, negotiate and manage relationships with affiliate networks, publishers, content creators and technology partners to secure high-quality, cost-effective placements.
* Own day-to-day channel operations: commission structuring, tracking and validation, compliance, and troubleshooting technical or performance issues.
* Use AI-driven tools and optimization, for example automated bid/commission optimisation, AI-assisted content, creative or audience targeting to improve campaign efficiency and free up time for strategic activity.
**Data, insight & reporting**
* Use data to drive decisions across the channel, analysing performance by partner, placement and campaign to identify what's working and reallocate budget accordingly.
* Own regular and ad hoc reporting for senior stakeholders, translating channel performance into clear commercial insight and recommendations.
* Partner with wider analytics/BI teams to improve attribution, measurement and incrementality understanding for the channel.
**Leadership & collaboration**
* Lead, coach and develop the affiliates team, setting clear priorities and creating capacity to scale as the channel grows.
* Act as the primary point of contact for the affiliates channel with cross-functional teams, including brand, finance and commercial, ensuring alignment on priorities and investment.

You aren’t tied to a specific framework or a single way of working and instead focus on the best outcome for the business. You have a track record of improving efficiency and modernising mobile release cycles, and you know how to navigate the technical and organisational trade-offs involved in those transitions.
* **Systems Thinking**: You naturally see the connection between technical foundations and team velocity. You focus on the system-level improvements that help every product team move faster.

We use the latest iterations of Flutter and Dart with a modular architecture to build scalable applications. Totara is a global learning platform trusted by more than 1,500 organisations and 21 million users worldwide. We help organisations build workforce readiness through flexible learning, compliance, and talent development solutions designed for complex and highly regulated environments across both the public and private sectors.
The RevOps Systems & Integration Lead owns how data moves across Totara's commercial stack. Accountability for this is currently fragmented: HubSpot has an owner, other tools do not, and data is often corrected downstream rather than at source. That rework grows as the business grows. This role creates a single accountable owner for the data layer, making data trustworthy, documented, native-first and reportable end to end, with the least complexity that works.
The role sits within Revenue Operations and works across Finance, Commercial, Customer Delivery and Product. It owns Syncari, the integration and data layer, and sets the cross-system data standards that other system owners work to. It also takes technical ownership of commercial tools that currently lack an internal owner, starting with Sage and ProjectWorks.
The role does not administer HubSpot, which has an existing owner, and does not build BI reports, which are produced by others. It owns the modelled data those reports sit on, and it sets the data standards HubSpot must meet as the primary source, agreed with the HubSpot owner.
The guiding principle is to fix defects at source rather than downstream. Syncari rules are the fallback, not the default, and a system that nobody understands is treated as a defect. To make that work, the role carries a mandate, backed by the Global Director, Revenue Operations, to require changes in source systems owned by others.
**Responsibilities:**
**Data platform and integration ownership (35 to 40%)**
* Own Syncari administration and the rules governing what data flows where
* Own cross-system data standards: format, mapping, deduplication and conflict handling
* Define, implement and document account hierarchy and parent-child mapping rules, aiming for one clear rule set rather than a growing list of per-case exceptions
* Build deduplication and cleansing controls source first, working upstream with system owners. Add rules in Syncari only where source-side control is not feasible
* Connect Athena (product usage data) into Syncari and ensure it flows into Power BI and HubSpot in the correct format, with conflicts handled
* Within the first 30 to 60 days, review the Syncari roadmap and integration backlog and propose the approach and priority order for outstanding integration work, including Athena and ProjectWorks, for confirmation by the Global Director, Revenue Operations, and CFO before implementation begins
**Data modelling for reporting (20 to 25%)**
* Own the modelled data layer feeding Power BI, structuring data so that key business reporting is simple and reliable
* Ensure CRM, finance, project and product usage data reconcile across systems
* Note: this is data modelling, not report building. Report building is done by others; this role owns the modelled data underneath
**System ownership and support for tools without an internal owner (15 to 20%)**
* Act as technical owner for commercial tools that lack an internal owner, initially Sage
* Provide system knowledge, first-line support and vendor liaison for ProjectWorks (our resource planning tool)
* Systematise routine administration so that it can be minimised or delegated over time, rather than growing
* Work with IT on access, security and compliance, and ensure changes are controlled and tested
**Documentation and enablement (10 to 15%)**
* Document the systems and the data flows, kept simple enough for non-specialists to follow
* Make clear to each system administrator what must stay stable and the operating rules that keep data working downstream
* Maintain documentation in a single source of truth, reviewing and sunsetting outdated material
* Support training and knowledge sharing so that system understanding is not held by one person
**Acquisition onboarding and exit readiness (5 to 10%)**
* As Totara acquires businesses, onboard their tools into the stack, kept to the minimum needed
* Support the data room and analytics layer for due diligence. The Global Director, Revenue Operations, and CFO hold the strategic judgement calls on scope and priority; this role executes against their direction
**Knowledge & Experience**
* Strong CRM experience. HubSpot experience strongly preferred, as HubSpot is and will remain the primary source of data
* Hands-on experience with at least one iPaaS, Master Data Management or ETL/ELT platform (for example Workato, Celigo, Boomi, Tray.io, Informatica, MuleSoft or Syncari). Syncari-specific experience is not required, and structured onboarding and ramp-up time will be provided
* Experience modelling data for business intelligence so that reporting is simple and reliable. Power BI is the target
* Experience working across business and technical teams, and owning problems end to end
* Experience administering or supporting business systems, and acting as a liaison with external vendors
**Skills**
* Demonstrable bias for simplicity: able to show where complexity was removed, not only where it was built
* Able to explain complex systems simply to non-technical stakeholders
* Fixes root causes rather than symptoms, and challenges unnecessary tooling, including whether Syncari is warranted for a given job
* Strong collaboration and influence without formal authority, able to align independent system owners
* Working knowledge of APIs, integrations and data mapping
* Strong documentation discipline, producing material that is lean, accessible and maintained
**Preferred, not essential**
* Working knowledge of SQL and cloud data tooling. Deep data warehousing or architecture-level depth is not required
* HubSpot Datasets and reporting tooling
* Lean and/or Six Sigma
* Finance-system administration (Sage or similar)
* No specific degree is required. Relevant professional experience is what matters
**What success looks like?**
* Data is consistent and trusted across systems, and business teams use it without manual workarounds
* Downstream cleansing shrinks over time rather than growing, because defects are fixed at source
* Key business reporting in Power BI sits on a stable, documented, modelled data layer
* Account hierarchy is governed by one clear rule set, not a growing list of exceptions
* Systems and data flows are documented well enough for non-specialists to follow, and no system depends on one person's memory
* Integrations are delivered reliably and to an agreed priority order
* Data is available and reliable for due diligence when required

* Private Healthcare
* Life Insurance 4x Salary
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Annual Wellbeing Allowance
* New Joiner home working set-up allowance

The role
As a Senior Product Manager at Typeform, you will own a meaningful product area and work closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Research, Marketing, and other teams to turn customer problems and business opportunities into products people genuinely want to use.

What you will do
Own the strategy and roadmap for a key area of the Typeform product.
Build a strong understanding of our customers, their workflows, and the problems they are trying to solve.
Identify opportunities through customer conversations, behavioural data, research, market insight, and product intuition.
Turn broad problems into clear product bets, hypotheses, and measurable outcomes.
Partner closely with Design and Engineering from discovery through delivery.
Work with Data and Research to understand customer behaviour and evaluate whether what we build is working.
Make thoughtful prioritisation decisions across customer needs, business goals, technical investment, and product quality.
Define success measures and use them to guide product decisions before and after launch.

Communicate product direction clearly and build alignment across teams and leadership.

Strong product judgement, with the ability to use customer insight, data, and context to make good decisions.
Close collaboration with Engineering and Design, with product development treated as a shared discipline.

Clear communication, with the ability to adapt complex ideas for different audiences.

Curiosity about AI and how it is changing the way products are built and how customers interact with software.

## Job Description
The Role
Unit4 is a market leader for ERP and finance solutions across universities, colleges, and the Canadian K-12 school board market. Higher education faces structural funding pressure, growing research complexity, and the demands of an increasingly digital student experience. School boards navigate provincial funding compliance, trustee governance, and the operational weight of collective agreements across large, geographically distributed organizations. As Product Director for Higher Education and K-12, you own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the platform of choice across these institutions.
This is not an account management or advisory role. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build vertical depth that distinguishes Unit4 in this market - capabilities that matter to a university CFO managing a research portfolio, a registrar navigating financial aid complexity, or a Superintendent of Business in a school board managing provincial budget allocations. You will work closely with horizontal product teams to ensure the platform delivers end-to-end, but the vertical product strategy is yours.
The right person has built enterprise software for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You understand the funding models, the compliance obligations, and where current systems fall short. You have shipped features that research finance officers, HR directors, and school board finance teams actually use.
AI is reshaping higher education from multiple directions simultaneously. Research institutions are navigating AI-assisted grant workflows, evolving indirect cost models, and new data governance obligations from research funders. Administratively, AI offers real efficiency gains across finance, procurement, and HR. Capturing those gains while maintaining the rigorous data governance, academic integrity, and accreditation standards these institutions operate within is the defining challenge. This role requires someone who understands both sides and can build a product roadmap that helps institutions move forward with confidence.

* Own the Higher Education and K-12 product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.
* Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

* Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates for HE and K-12 institutions.

* Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement for new capabilities.
* Engage directly with strategic customers and the HE Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and capture outcome evidence.
* Ensure regulatory, accessibility, research-compliance, and provincial requirements across our supported geographies are systematically reflected in the roadmap.
* Monitor the competitive landscape - know what Ellucian, Workday, Microsoft, Tribal Group, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4's positioning.
* Work with partners to extend the value proposition for HE and K-12 customers.
* Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.
* Serve as the internal authority on the Higher Education and K-12 verticals, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.
What You'll Bring
* Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP, finance systems, or enterprise SaaS - for higher education institutions or K-12 school boards. You have shipped products used by HE finance teams, research administrators, or school board operations staff, not just studied the sector.
* Deep working knowledge of higher education finance: research grant accounting, fund and restricted-fund accounting, full economic costing, endowments, and tuition revenue models.
* For the K-12 dimension: working knowledge of provincial ministry funding formulas, trustee governance and board reporting, school-level budget delegation, and collective agreement administration.
* Understanding of the student lifecycle interfaces - financial aid, tuition management, integration with student information systems - and what they demand from the ERP layer.
* A clear point of view on how AI is reshaping the research enterprise and administrative operations of HE institutions, and what responsible, governance-compliant product decisions look like in this context.
* Commercial orientation: you understand how product decisions drive ARR, win rate, and customer retention.
* Strong communication skills at CFO, VP Finance, Superintendent of Business, and senior academic and school board leadership level.

* Deep understanding of professional services business models, including project-based delivery, utilization, billing, scheduling and compliance.
* Strong ability to influence without authority and work cross-functionally in a matrixed environment.
* Proven ability to translate complex industry needs into scalable product solutions.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder engagement skills.

# Customer Host (12 HRS)
Please, note this role is a 12 hours contract and weekend availability may be required.
**WHO WE ARE**
White Stuff was established in 1985 through a simple idea. This idea grew and now we have shops and concessions in the UK and internationally, selling women’s and men’s clothing as well as beautiful accessories and homeware. Our original prints (all designed in house), intricate details and considered design touches reflect our personality and make us subtly distinctive.
Our people are at the heart of our brand, constantly moving and driving us forward. We’re sociable, talented and like minded and we’re not hierarchical or political in how we do business. We encourage entrepreneurial ideas and accountability at all levels.
**WHO YOU ARE**
You’ll be passionate about Retail and Fashion. You will have the determination to go the extra mile and provide the best customer experience. You will thrive in a team environment, and you will inspire others with your passion and support.
**PRIMARY OBJECTIVE OF THE JOB**
Ensure we are the best on the high street for delivering an amazing customer experience.
**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**
You’ll report to the Shop Manager and sit within our Retail team.
**Customer Experience**
* Meeting the A.C.E pillars (Be Friendly, Be Inspiring and Be Invaluable) throughout the Customer Journey.
* Holding an understanding of shop KPIs and working to continuously improve them.
* Promoting multichannel shopping by using the mobile point of sale system (mPOS) to show customers the products available across our channels and creating endless aisle orders.
* Engaging customers with our brand by signing customers up to email newsletters, tagging their purchases to their profile, and sending e-receipts in line with data protection regulations.
* Using knowledge of promotions or discounts available to inform our customers and increase sales.
* Assisting in events including Customer Event and preview evenings.
**Product Presentation and Visual Standards**
* Maintaining high visual standards instore.
* Supporting with floor moves, mannequin and window displays, and replenishment.
* Understanding the features (fits, style, fabrics) of our product ranges and explaining these to our customers to support their buying decisions.
**Shop Operations**
* Processing deliveries efficiently and ensuring that on the shop floor products are replenished and always available for customers
* Supporting in stock management processes such as stocktakes.
* Using company resources such as the White Stuff website, Looking White Stuff, the Tea Room, email communications, window guidelines and brand posts to engage with our customer and ensure compliance with daily/weekly actions.
* Being a team player and playing an active role in team briefs.
* Understanding and complying with the Health & Safety and emergency procedures in store.
* Having a professional approach to our internal customers, head office departments, centre management (where applicable) and any other visitors.
* Efficient and accurately fulfilling ship from store and Click + Collect processes.
**Doing Good Stuff**
* Holding an awareness of our charity partner and the positive impact this has including supporting any events or charity promotions.
* Understanding our approach to ethical sourcing and environmental impact to be able to explain this to our customers and the team.
**Benefits**
As a Customer Host at White Stuff you will be entitled to an array of great benefits, some of which include:
* Quarterly bonus opportunity
* Up to 25 days holiday per annum plus bank holidays
* 2 days paid (as per your contracted hours) per year to volunteer in the local community
* 50% product discount
* Annual uniform allowance
* BUPA Dental Insurance
* Healthcare cash plan and Life Assurance
* Interest free season ticket loan
* Pension Contribution
*We are committed to creating an environment where we can all be proud to work and be ourselves. Part of this commitment is being an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, and age.*

## Role Overview
This is an owner-side technical asset management role supporting the safe, reliable and commercially effective operation of the Lynn & Inner Dowsing Offshore Wind Farm. The successful candidate will act as the technical focal point between asset owners, contractors and service providers, combining practical offshore wind judgement with commercial awareness and governance discipline.
This position is ideally suited to an experienced offshore wind professional seeking to transition from operational delivery into owner-side asset management.
The role is not responsible for performing maintenance activities. Instead, the successful candidate will oversee, challenge and support the organisations that do, using technical evidence to protect asset value and improve operational outcomes.
The successful candidate will develop a detailed understanding of the technical condition, operational performance and risk profile of the asset and will play a key role in supporting owner decisions regarding performance, risk, expenditure and long-term value creation.
## Role and Responsibilities
**Asset Performance**
* Act as the owner-side technical lead for Lynn & Inner Dowsing Offshore Wind Farm.
* Develop and maintain a detailed understanding of the technical and operational condition of the wind farm, including wind turbines, electrical infrastructure, marine operations and supporting systems.
* Monitor production, availability, losses, technical performance and operational risk across the asset.
* Analyse SCADA data, operational reports, work orders and technical information to identify trends, recurring issues and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the identification and implementation of operational improvement initiatives that enhance safety, reliability and asset value.
**O&M Oversight**
* Work closely with the O&M Contractor to ensure maintenance activities are delivered safely, effectively and in accordance with contractual obligations.
* Challenge contractor performance where appropriate using objective operational and technical evidence.
* Review maintenance plans, campaign strategies, outage planning and major interventions.
* Monitor contractor KPIs, performance guarantees, service quality and response times.
* Support contractor audits and performance reviews where required.
**Technical Risk & Reliability**
* Maintain awareness of emerging technical risks, reliability concerns and fleet-wide issues that could affect asset performance.
* Support root cause investigations relating to operational incidents, major defects and equipment failures.
* Review engineering modifications, technical recommendations and reliability improvement proposals.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of technical risk registers and mitigation plans.
**Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong working relationships with asset owners, contractors, consultants and key industry stakeholders.
* Lead or support technical review meetings with contractors and specialist suppliers.
* Coordinate with commercial asset managers, HSE specialists, regulatory advisers and grid stakeholders where required.
* Support shareholder, board and client reporting through the provision of clear technical insight and recommendations.
**Reporting & Governance**
* Prepare and deliver monthly technical performance updates for asset owners.
* Present complex technical issues in a concise and commercially relevant manner.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and operational expenditure reviews relating to asset performance activities.
* Contribute to continual improvement of XceCo reporting products, asset management systems and technical processes.
**Site Engagement**
* Undertake periodic site visits, vessel visits and contractor engagement activities to maintain a practical understanding of asset condition and operational performance.
* Maintain visibility of offshore operational challenges and developing industry best practice.
## Qualifications and Experience
**Essential**
* Significant experience within the offshore wind industry.
* Experience as an Authorised Technician, Senior Technician, Production Engineer, Production Manager, Service Engineer, Operations Engineer or similar role on operational offshore wind farms.
* Strong understanding of offshore wind operational performance, maintenance activities and technical risk management.
* Experience interpreting operational reports, SCADA trends, technical data and maintenance records.
* Ability to engage confidently with technicians, engineers, contractors and senior stakeholders.
* Full UK Driving Licence.
**Desirable**
* Siemens SWT-3.6 experience.
* Experience working in owner-side asset management.
* Experience reviewing O&M agreements and performance obligations.
* Knowledge of balance of plant systems, substations, foundations, subsea assets, export systems or marine operations.
* Engineering degree, HNC, apprenticeship or equivalent technical qualification.
## Person Specification
* Technically credible with offshore delivery teams.
* Sound engineering judgement with a practical understanding of offshore wind operations.
* Naturally inquisitive, analytical and evidence-led.
* Comfortable challenging established views professionally and objectively.
* Able to understand how technical decisions influence commercial outcomes.
* Capable of working independently while contributing positively to a small, high-performing team.
* Confident presenting technical information to non-technical audiences.
* High levels of integrity, accountability and professionalism.
